newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Telekom award probe completed soon-Anwar.
newsitem.headline: Telekom award probe completed soon-Anwar.

text.p: A probe into suspected irregularities involving an award of a contract by Telekom Malaysia Bhd to Sweden's LM Ericsson is expected to be completed soon, Malaysia's Deputy Prime Minister said on Tuesday.
Anwar Ibrahim said Telekom and the Finance Ministry had been instructed to expedite the investigation.
"We have asked them to speed up," he told reporters after opening a capital markets conference.
Anwar, who has been updated on the progress of the investigation, said there was a basis to investigate further.
"There is basis in terms of transparency or procedures that need to be observed. Based on the preliminary reports submitted, I think they will have to probe deep," he said.
He said it was premature for him to comment on whether there had been any breach in the tender award.
Details about the contract in question have not been disclosed. The pact was said to be awarded between 1992 and 1993.
